Description: Fix GeoJSON polygons that cross the antimeridian The antimeridian Python package provides functions to fix shapes that cross the antimeridian. . It can fix: . * Shapely Polygon, MultiPolygon, LineString, and MultiLineString objects * GeoJSON Polygons, MultiPolygons, Features and FeatureCollections, as dictionaries * Anything that has a __geo_interface__
